title: Canonical Language Documentation & Source Migration Gate

packages.title: Classify and migrate the canonical language documentation and committed source surface.
acceptance_criteria: Exhaustively account for every committed AIDL source and documented syntax surface, including all three reference applications and all committed fixtures, against the frozen M10.1 language authority.

Classify every source or documentation surface as production-admitted canonical, canonical-but-not-yet-admitted, legacy-readable compatibility, negative/rejection fixture, or illustrative/aspirational material; newly unclassified grammar/source/documentation surfaces fail closed in deterministic CI checks.

Align docs/06-grammar.md and relevant overview, core, diagnostics, evolution, and reference documentation to the frozen unified target design and eliminate contradictory legacy syntax from normative target-language documentation without changing compiler/parser/runtime/Canonical-IR semantics.

Preserve explicit distinctions between parser readability, production semantic admission, compatibility-only readability, rejection expectations, and illustrative material for all reference applications and fixtures.
Do not widen the frozen Production Semantic Envelope implicitly; any semantic or admission change is deferred to an explicit versioned contract decision.
